    nodes = case['nodes']  # list of dicts
    required = set(case['required_symbols'])

    # Build dict by id
    node_map = {n['id']: n for n in nodes}
    # Build children lists
    children = {n['id']: [] for n in nodes}
    for n in nodes:
        pid = n['parent']
        if pid is not None:
            children[pid].append(n['id'])

    retained = set(n['id'] for n in nodes)
    removed = []

    # Candidates: all nodes that are removable and not required symbol? Actually check later: we will filter in loop.
    candidates = [n for n in nodes if n['removable']]
    # Sort: deeper first (higher depth), then by id string
    candidates.sort(key=lambda n: (-n['depth'], n['id']))

    for node in candidates:
        nid = node['id']
        if nid not in retained:
            continue
        # Cannot remove if symbol is required
        if node['symbol'] in required:
            continue
        # Cannot remove if has any retained children
        has_retained_children = any(cid in retained for cid in children[nid])
        if has_retained_children:
            continue
        # Check required symbols still represented after removal
        # Compute symbol counts or just check subset
        # Remove temporarily
        retained.remove(nid)
        # Check
        symbols_retained = set(node_map[nid2]['symbol'] for nid2 in retained)
        if required.issubset(symbols_retained):
            # Keep removed
            removed.append(nid)
        else:
            # Re-add
            retained.add(nid)

    # Sort retained IDs (string sort)
    retained_sorted = sorted(retained)
    return {
        "removed_node_ids": removed,
        "retained_node_ids": retained_sorted
    }
